name: Adlaba Kurn
found: The Bloated Leech, working the room.
appearance: Early 40s. Easy smile. Apron pockets heavy with coin.
sayings: Half my regulars pray with Peryl. Half want him drowned.
wants: A full house, a good night’s take.
knows: Who still prays at the shuttered temple.
family: Son Gerly, a fighter, works the door.
